scoring_justification: The checker cannot rerun the full VFF calculation, so it compares the agent's reported min_config to the paper-derived stability boundary from Fig. 2.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold phase boundary (4C10Sn vs 1C4Sn) equality curve
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from Fig. 2 of the source paper (Elyukhin et al., Physica E 40 (2008) 883-885).
hidden_assets.generation_method: The curve appears linear; we extracted the approximate line slope 1.875 and intercept -0.0025 from the figure. This matches the paper's equality condition.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The boundary is derived from the paper's published result; it is used as the hidden gold to verify the agent's reproduction.

outputs.description: CSV file containing free energy data per composition and the minimum-energy cluster configuration.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the min_config column against a digitized reference stability boundary and scores the classification accuracy.
